executor.thread_title: Goose Sim2Sim 训练任务 Picking

predecessor.result: Local suspended hold not qualified; hardware root not determined; no inference of dragging failure.

user_priority: Preserve goose-like biomimetic appearance while maximizing practical sustainable payload and backward ground-drag capacity. Prioritize heavy ground dragging; retain100g lift as regression, not a prerequisite or drag upper limit.
question: With sealed04 hardware, which ground-supported loads can the beak retain and transmit useful backward pull to, and what fails first: acquisition/escape, neck/drive, stance/feet/body control, or unresolved contact numerics?

primary_conditions.payload: Same complete handle/arms/box family as first pilot; physical ballast in unchanged box; update payload mass/COM/fullI from component allocations. Robot unchanged.
primary_conditions.mass_limit_claim: exploratory tested range only; do not claim a maximum without a successful/failed bracket or exceed plausible ballast density
primary_conditions.friction_rule: Read back actual mixed contacts. Explicit scene object-ground pairs may implement declared ground material; robot/jaw material and model solver stay sealed04. No arbitrary friction reduction.
primary_conditions.payload_start: Initially supported by floor, no deep overlap; cold near-grasp pose may isolate loaded-contact behavior but does not qualify full autonomous pickup.

sequence: Read first PM review/returned data; reuse verified interfaces rather than repeat the same full audit. Verify new scene robot fields, name mapping, ground contacts and complete payload MCI.

At most one initial LOCAL_TORSO_FIXED_NECK_PULL pilot is preferred if needed for admission. Torso fixture must be stationary and declared; head/neck/jaw must move only through actual joint actuators. No moving head/world fixture.

Prioritize FREE_BASE_BACKDRAG pilot once an admitted physical posture/control path exists. Robot root must be free; no support/pose writes/world weld during this mode. Use bounded named existing control or teacher logic, record source; no training.

Use remaining attempts for heavier mass or a single purposeful posture/grasp-location comparison based on observed failure, keeping hardware/material/solver identical. Include an explicit free-base feasibility attempt if valid birth/control admission permits.

If no usable free-base controller/posture is available, return precise control/mechanical/numerical prerequisites promptly; remaining useful true-neck local pulls must be explicitly local. Do not expand into controller/framework development or long training.

metrics.startup: Within5s, positive backward object displacement>=20mm; record if not met.
metrics.local_neck_pull: Aim50–100mm actual object ground displacement using real neck actuation; report achieved stroke, force, posture and fixture reactions. It never qualifies whole-body backward dragging.
metrics.whole_robot_gate: Both torso reference and complete object backward>=0.5m, duration>=max(10s,0.5/target speed), mean speed within20%, stop<=0.1m, retain3s after stop. Short pilot is labelled partial, not complete.
metrics.sustained: Record observed duration and loaded force; if a viable case supports a60s check within the same attempt/budget, do so; untested60s is unqualified. Separate startup/short stroke/sustained limits.
metrics.grip: Stay in real jaw grasp domain, transmit actual backward contact load, no rolling out/drop or non-mouth robot pushing. Report slip rate/position, rotation, margin to escape and contact wrenches. Do not mechanically apply suspended static2mm/2deg gate to adaptive drag posture.
metrics.flat_vs_partial: Report separately. Flat nominal average ground normal>=90%mg without deliberate lifting. Partial: contact>=95%time, no full flight>0.1s; ground normal<10%mg is near-suspension and excluded from main drag claim.
metrics.stability: Record actual torso/root displacement/orientation, foot stance slip and ground reaction, support changes, falls/self collisions, joint ROM, pin residuals and penetration. Reference stance slip<=5mm/stance and<=20mm/m for whole-body qualification.
metrics.drives: Actual applied torque/velocity/torque-speed/voltage/positive power and limiting duty; continuous mode only, peak disabled. Distinguish target slew from motor physical curve; record actual speed and limits rather than projecting velocities.

allowed_changes: Lab isolated scene, payload ballast/initial pose/ground material conditions exactly declared
Bounded control requests through the same frozen actuator envelope, with source and behavior scope declared
Stationary torso-only fixture in clearly labelled local neck-pull mode; no head fixation that supplies the pull
CPU inference using a named existing policy only if useful; count inference separately, never inherit old-body qualification
prohibited_changes: Payload adhesion/attachment/online repositioning, root pose or velocity writes, moving fixture/mocap propulsion
Unreported external pulling/holding forces or classifying equivalent applied-force loads as real robot dragging
Solver/condim/friction changes to obtain passing04 numbers, fabricated low-friction or airborne drag success
GPU use, training updates, automatic continuation or a second concurrent experiment executor
required_return: Acceptance/deadline and actual resource/exit receipts; immutable input, payload, scene, controller and engine identities
All actual attempts and per-substep states/forces/ground normals/foot slip/relative grasp poses/actual drives/closed-loop residuals and penetration
Separate LOCAL_TORSO_FIXED_NECK_PULL and FREE_BASE_BACKDRAG results; actual mass/friction/start/sustain/distance/escape boundary and failure cause certainty
Original1x continuous representative success/failure videos bound to actual trajectory; no appearance redraw, hidden resets or cuts
Self-contained summary, source snapshots/reproduction and raw data paths; no claim of formal repeat reliability or global mass maximum from exploratory cases
Minimal evidence-backed design implications under goose appearance constraint; leave geometry/controller/training implementation open until justified
stop: Return when scoped evidence is available, admission is blocked or deadline reaches3600s. Max5 cases, fifth not mandatory. Preserve failures; no automatic additional batch.
